description:
⋗Usage Notes⋖
▪ All special symbols in the widgets are only key icons - they have no original symbol meaning or other special meaning!
▪ This widget suggests the phone font is <default font> <smallest size>, unless you don't mind possible text alignment issues from fonts
▪ Some keys inside can be custom-bound, but need some key knowledge

⋗Design⋖
▪ Base: lightly inspired by Genshin Impact and Wuthering Waves key layouts, adapted for MC
▪ Core: four-finger, feel, simplicity, innovation, quality, functions, large-scale

⋗Update Contents⋖
▪ Optimized screens for [Key Module], [◧Mods], [◨Game], [KCommand Library], [❖More]
▪ Optimized text layout of [KCommand Library] and [❖More]
▪ Optimized layout of some keys on out-of-game and in-game main screens
▪ Optimized border sizes of all bordered key styles
▪ Sorted key styles A~Z
▪ Replaced some key text with icons
▪ Unified most widget parameters and name formats
▪ Added custom key binds for default keys of [Litematica], [Tweakeroo], [MiniHUD], [Xaero's Minimap], [Xaero's World Map], [Mod Menu]
▪ Added 71 new quick commands
▪ Added auto spam for some keys
▪ Added [More.Use2] and [More.Custom2] screens
▪ Default out-of-game key module selection is [Common]
▪ Fixed "F" and "G" key positions swapped in [wFullKeyboard]
▪ Fixed accidentally switching in/out screens when opening [❖More], making it impossible to close
▪ Other
